source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.
source.location: Results section 2.5 text (Figure 5B,C): 'Control non-induced embryos treated with Concanamycin A ... 22.6% ... (n = 110)'

stage: NF stage 27 at eye ablation (embryos injected at NF stage 3, four-cell, with GFP and dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA)
injury: surgical ablation of the left eye tissue, about 85% removed (lens placode and most of the optic cup), at NF stage 27

intervention.duration: from surgery; end of exposure not stated (assay at 5 days post-surgery)
intervention.description: Eye-ablated embryos carrying dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA bathed in 20 nM concanamycin A after surgery, with no dexamethasone added

readout.method: eye size and morphology scored into full, partial, weak or none regrowth categories (Regrowth Index)

notes: 22.6% fully regrown (RI = 131), n=110 -> 25/110. 'other' = eyes not fully regrown (partial, weak or none regrowth pooled; the text gives only % full regrowth, and the split is in a graph not on disk). Full regrowth (same size and morphology as unoperated sibling) mapped to normal. Count = round(% x n). Embryos carry the uninduced GR-NICD construct.

adjudication.note: both 25/85; B put the non-full remainder in eye_defect, but pooled partial/weak/none is a partial-phenotype mix, so other (A); role test (A had control)

source.title: Notch Is Required for Neural Progenitor Proliferation During Embryonic Eye Regrowth.
source.location: Results section 2.5 text (Figure 5B,C): 'embryos expressing NICD in the presence of Concanamycin A resulted in 75.5% ... (n = 106)'; injection and Dex dose from Methods

stage: NF stage 27 at eye ablation (embryos injected at NF stage 3, four-cell, with GFP and dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA)
injury: surgical ablation of the left eye tissue, about 85% removed (lens placode and most of the optic cup), at NF stage 27

intervention.duration: from surgery; end of exposure not stated (assay at 5 days post-surgery)
intervention.description: Eye-ablated embryos carrying dexamethasone-inducible NICD mRNA (0.25 ng, four-cell stage) bathed in 20 nM concanamycin A plus 10 uM dexamethasone after surgery

readout.method: eye size and morphology scored into full, partial, weak or none regrowth categories (Regrowth Index)

notes: 75.5% fully regrown (RI = 260), n=106 -> 80/106. 'other' = eyes not fully regrown (partial, weak or none regrowth pooled; the text gives only % full regrowth, and the split is in a graph not on disk). Full regrowth (same size and morphology as unoperated sibling) mapped to normal. Count = round(% x n). Dose field = concanamycin A.

adjudication.note: counts agree; non-full remainder in other rather than eye_defect; duration_h null (A had assumed 120 h)
